definition: Large Language and Vision Assistant, an end-to-end trained large multimodal model that connects a vision encoder and LLM for general purpose visual and language understanding.
details: Large Language and Vision Assistant, an end-to-end trained large multimodal model that connects a vision encoder and LLM for general purpose visual and language understanding.

explainer.lead: LLaVA (Large Language and Vision Assistant) is an end-to-end trained large multimodal model connecting a vision encoder and an LLM for general-purpose visual and language understanding. It matters because it unifies image perception and language reasoning in one model.

tiers.eli5: It's an AI that can look at a picture and talk about it, like a friend who describes and answers questions about a photo.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use LLaVA for tasks that require reasoning over images and text together, such as visual question answering. A pitfall is that errors in the vision encoder's representation can propagate to the language output.
tiers.paperLevel: LLaVA is an end-to-end trained large multimodal model that connects a vision encoder and an LLM for general-purpose visual and language understanding. No formal formula or quantified limits are given.

explainer.example: A user uploads a photo of a kitchen and asks what appliance is on the counter; LLaVA answers based on the image.
